integrity: Exact geometric proof and standalone arithmetic finite-field checks; no fabricated authorship or external certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the fixed degree-nine reduced integral model over F_p for p>3 and all finite extensions; no assertion of modular freeness, no coverage of p=2 or 3, no independent priority or external validation. The sextic and its old complex singularity profile, and the characteristic-zero free divisor, are prior literature.
title: Frobenius-split nodes and the zeta function of a maximizing degree-nine free curve
